name: auction-marketplace
description: Full-stack auction marketplace with React, Node.js, Prisma, and Stripe

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: concurrently --raw --names "backend,frontend" "npm run test --prefix backend" "npm run test --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: biome check --write . && biome format --write . && tsc --noEmit && biome check .
